name: Foggy Harbour Realism
description: A calm near-photoreal scene look with soft painted surfaces in deep atmospheric haze, grey-teal and slate, one restrained warm accent, nothing moving and no faces close to camera.
style_bible: Near-photoreal painted stillness: the surface of a carefully finished oil or gouache study handled so tightly that it reads almost as a photograph, with brushwork visible only where a near edge catches the light. Medium and surface: smooth blended passages, no exposed canvas tooth, no impasto except a few small highlights on hard and reflective surfaces, an even matte finish. Edges and shapes: soft everywhere and softer with distance — foreground objects hold a clean but unlined edge, the middle ground loses its edges to the scene's own air, the far ground dissolves entirely into flat tone with only a silhouette left. Palette: grey-teal, slate, pewter, drab green and cold off-white, desaturated throughout and kept within a narrow band of value, with one restrained warm accent spilling amber into a small part of the frame and nowhere else. Lighting: flat, diffuse light with no visible source, softly filtered where the scene has haze, contrast deliberately low, no hard shadows, no strong highlights, no rim light; the warm accent glows rather than illuminates and never casts a dramatic beam. Texture: where the scene has haze, it is real depth rather than an overlay, with damp sheen on near surfaces where present, fine condensation, and soft broken reflections. Subject grammar: one clear focal subject held in a narrow, low-contrast tonal band, with every surface softened where the scene's air softens it and nothing moving. Where the scene has depth, compose one crisp near detail, a readable but softened middle ground, and distance beyond; never add haze the scene did not ask for. Framing: eye-level or slightly above, any horizon kept low, generous open negative space, subject placed off-centre and small within the frame. Low stimulation is the contract: nothing is in motion, nothing is beginning or ending, no faces appear in close-up, no crowds, no high contrast, no incident. Keep it content-independent: no fixed subject, place, event, or copied composition.
negative_prompt: saturated colour, high contrast, hard shadows, dramatic god rays, action, running or fighting figures, close-up faces, head-and-shoulders crops, crowds, busy scenes, neon, signage, readable text, lettering, captions, logos, watermarks, signatures, frames, borders, UI elements, HDR look, heavy vignette, cartoon, anime, flat vector, copied reference composition
